label: Selected projects
title: Two projects, from the first drawing to the last handle.
cta: A project like this starts with a conversation.

house.name: A family house, Tbilisi
house.quote: “One kitchen that runs the whole house.”
house.text: White fronts and walnut uppers around a marble island on a fluted base. A wine rack behind glass turns the corner into the living room, where a long walnut bench carries the television. We drew, made and installed all of it.

1.title: Made to this house
1.text: Every cabinet drawn to the millimetre around the stairs, the windows and the appliances.

2.title: Appliances built in
2.text: Oven, microwave and fridge sit flush in the fronts — framed, not squeezed in.

3.title: One material story
3.text: The walnut of the upper cabinets returns on the island base and on the living-room bench.

pair.1: Walnut uppers over a marble splashback.
pair.2: The oven column, flush with the fronts.

lobby.name: A lobby and café, Tbilisi
lobby.quote: “One detail that holds a whole floor together.”
lobby.text: Oak-slat columns and partitions, a mirror wall cut into a half moon, arched shelving and a fluted counter in the café — one hand across an entire ground floor, from the lobby to the corridors.

1.title: Slats and light
1.text: Backlit oak slats on the columns, the partitions and the corridor wall.

2.title: Joinery at the scale of a building
2.text: Partitions, shelving, counters and benches, all from one workshop.

3.title: Fitted around a working business
3.text: Measured on site and installed in stages, without closing the doors.
